svg.title: HELMET's default response headers, drawn as a play
svg.desc: A chalk play diagram. Seven circles on the line of scrimmage are the seven headers HELMET sends by default, and each runs a route to its name and value, in the order HELMET sets them: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self' (+ 7 more directives, a fresh nonce, 'strict-dynamic'); X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN; Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin; Permissions-Policy: camera=(), geolocation=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=(); Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin; Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains (HTTPS responses only). Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy waits on the bench: it is opt-in.

g.text: every response, in the order HELMET sets them
